race.comment: SHOWTIME MAGGIE (10) missed behind Bosco two back before bumping into the Highway-bound Skibidi most recently at this track and trip. She draws a much better gate this time and that should see her closer in the run. Guymer sticks and she can go one better in this suitable assignment. LADY GOT BLING (9) is better than we saw last time out, tiring to be 2.2L off the winner over 1400m. Back to this trip suits and she still has plenty of upside. Can bounce back in a big way. DIAMOND FROST (2) got the job done in a photo last start when sneaking up the inside on a heavy deck at Nowra. The claim of Ellison comes in handy and with a touch of luck in running, he can be in the finish again. SELHURST PARK (6) is racing well and can't be left out of calculations. SIR LUNCHALOTS (7) won't be far away.
